title: mail: /.well-known/jmap redirect
description:
Add GET /.well-known/jmap to the axum router returning 301 redirect to /jmap/session (RFC 8620 §2). No auth required on this redirect endpoint.

Why: autoconfig discovery (Thunderbird, other clients) looks up /.well-known/jmap to bootstrap without manual server entry.

Acceptance: curl -I /.well-known/jmap returns 301 Location: /jmap/session.
